paras.en: I soon came to know this flower better. There had always been very simple flowers on the little prince’s planet, adorned with just one ring of petals, taking up no room and troubling no one. They would appear in the grass one morning, then fade away that evening. But this one had sprouted one day from a seed brought from no one knew where, and the little prince had kept a very close watch on this little shoot, which was unlike the other little shoots. It might be a new kind of baobab. But the shrub soon stopped growing and began to prepare a flower. As the little prince watched an enormous bud take shape, he felt sure that something miraculous would appear from within it, but the flower went on and on preparing to be beautiful, sheltered in her green room. She chose her colours with care. She dressed slowly, arranging her petals one by one. She did not want to come out all crumpled like the poppies. She wanted to appear only in the full radiance of her beauty. Oh, yes. She did love to look pretty! So her mysterious dressing and grooming went on for days and days. And then one morning, at the very moment the sun rose, she showed herself.
paras.zh: 我很快就更了解这朵花了。小王子的星球上一直有些很朴素的花，只有一圈花瓣作装饰，既不占地方，也不打扰任何人。她们在某个清晨出现在草丛里，到了晚上便熄灭了。可这一朵，有一天从一颗不知从哪里带来的种子里发了芽，小王子便仔细观察着这根与别的小枝条都不一样的小枝条。这可能是一种新的猴面包树。不过，这株小灌木很快就停止了生长，开始准备开一朵花。小王子看着一个硕大的花苞渐渐成形，心里明白，会有一个奇迹般的身影从中显现，可是，这朵花躲在她绿色的房间里，为了让自己变得美丽，准备起来没完没了。她仔细挑选自己的颜色。她慢慢穿戴，把花瓣一片片整理妥当。她不愿像虞美人那样，浑身皱巴巴地出来。她只愿在自己的美丽光彩尽放时露面。哎，是呀。她可爱美了！就这样，她神神秘秘地梳妆打扮，一天又一天。后来，一个清晨，恰好在太阳升起的那一刻，她现身了。

paras.en: And she, who had worked with such precision, said with a yawn:
paras.zh: 而她，这样精心准备了一番，却打着哈欠说：

paras.en: “Ah! I am only just waking up... Please forgive me... My hair is still all untidy...”
paras.zh: “啊！我才刚醒……请您原谅……我的头发还乱着呢……”

paras.en: Then the little prince could not hold back his admiration:
paras.zh: 这时，小王子忍不住赞叹道：

paras.en: “How beautiful you are!”
paras.zh: “您真美！”

paras.en: “Aren’t I?” the flower replied softly. “And I was born at the same time as the sun...”
paras.zh: “是吧？”花儿轻声回答。“而且，我和太阳是同时诞生的……”

paras.en: The little prince could tell that she was not very modest, but he was so moved by her!
paras.zh: 小王子看得出，她不怎么谦虚，可她是多么动人啊！

paras.en: “It is time for breakfast, I think,” she soon added. “Would you be kind enough to think of me...”
paras.zh: “我想，该吃早饭了，”她很快又说，“能不能请您好心想想我……”

paras.en: And the little prince, quite embarrassed, went to fetch a watering can of fresh water and served the flower.
paras.zh: 小王子很不好意思，便去取来一只装满清凉的水的洒水壶，侍候花儿用餐。

paras.en: And so she soon tormented him with her rather touchy vanity. One day, for instance, speaking of her four thorns, she said to the little prince:
paras.zh: 就这样，她那有些敏感的虚荣心，很快便让他受了折磨。比如，有一天，说起自己的四根刺，她对小王子说：

paras.en: “Let the tigers come, with their claws!”
paras.zh: “让老虎来好了，带着它们的爪子来！”

paras.en: “There are no tigers on my planet,” the little prince had objected, “and besides, tigers don’t eat grass.”
paras.zh: “我的星球上没有老虎，”小王子反驳道，“再说，老虎也不吃草。”

paras.en: “I’m not a blade of grass,” the flower had replied gently.
paras.zh: “我不是一棵草。”花轻轻地回答。

paras.en: “Forgive me…”
paras.zh: “请原谅我……”

paras.en: “I have nothing to fear from tigers, but I hate draughts. Would you happen to have a screen?”
paras.zh: “老虎没什么让我害怕的，可我讨厌穿堂风。你有没有一扇屏风呢？”

paras.en: “Hating draughts… that’s unlucky for a plant,” the little prince had remarked. “This flower is very complicated…”
paras.zh: “讨厌穿堂风……对一株植物来说，这可真不走运，”小王子说，“这朵花真复杂……”

paras.en: “In the evening you will put me under a glass globe. It’s very cold where you live. Things are badly arranged here. Where I come from…”
paras.zh: “到了晚上，你要把我罩在玻璃罩里。你这里很冷。布置得不好。在我来的那个地方……”

paras.en: But she had broken off. She had come as a seed. She could have known nothing of other worlds. Humiliated at having let herself be caught making up such a naive lie, she had coughed two or three times to put the little prince in the wrong:
paras.zh: 可她忽然停住了。她来的时候还是一粒种子。她不可能知道别的世界是什么样的。她正要编出这么一个天真的谎话，却让自己露了馅，觉得很丢脸，便咳了两三声，好让小王子反倒成了理亏的人：

paras.en: “That screen?…”
paras.zh: “那扇屏风呢？……”

paras.en: “I was going to fetch it, but you were talking to me!”
paras.zh: “我正要去拿，可你一直在跟我说话！”

paras.en: So she had made herself cough harder, to make him feel guilty all the same.
paras.zh: 于是她故意咳得更厉害，好让他即便这样也还是感到内疚。

paras.en: And so the little prince, despite all the goodwill in his love, had soon begun to doubt her. He had taken words of no importance seriously, and had become very unhappy.
paras.zh: 就这样，小王子虽然满怀善意地爱着她，却很快对她起了疑心。他把那些无关紧要的话当了真，变得很不快乐。

paras.en: “I should not have listened to her,” he confided to me one day. “You must never listen to flowers. You must look at them and breathe in their scent. Mine filled my planet with fragrance, but I did not know how to enjoy it. All that talk of claws, which had annoyed me so much, should have softened my heart…”
paras.zh: “我那时不该听她的话，”有一天，他向我吐露心事，“永远不要听花儿说些什么。应该看着她们，闻闻她们的香气。我的那朵花让我的星球满是芬芳，我却不懂得为此欢喜。那些关于爪子的话，曾让我那么烦恼，其实本该让我心生怜爱……”

paras.en: He confided something else to me:
paras.zh: 他又向我吐露心事：

paras.en: “I understood nothing then! I should have judged her by her actions, not her words. She surrounded me with fragrance and gave me light. I should never have run away! I should have sensed her tenderness behind her poor little tricks. Flowers are so full of contradictions! But I was too young to know how to love her.”
paras.zh: “我那时什么都不懂！我应该凭她做的事来判断她，而不是凭她说的话。她用芬芳围绕着我，用光亮照耀着我。我绝不该逃走！我应该从她那些拙劣的小把戏背后，察觉到她的温柔。花儿是多么矛盾啊！可我那时太年幼，还不懂得怎样爱她。”
